item.title: [data-breach] Booking.com data breach: Customer reservation data exposed
item.description: <p>&#8220;Unauthorized third parties may have been able to access certain booking information associated with your reservation,&#8221; email alerts sent out by Booking.com over the weekend warn. The online travel agency did not say which system(s) were accessed by the unauthorized third parties nor explained the scope of the incident.
